channel.title: Arjun - Writing
channel.description: Technical articles, opinion pieces, and case studies by Arjun.

item.title: Building a Self-Updating Daily-Agenda Wallpaper
item.description: How I turned my laptop wallpaper into a self-updating daily agenda: a designed poster rendered from HTML via headless Chrome, wired into Hyprland, with a self-cleaning quote feed.

item.title: I reverse-engineered my motorcycle's Bluetooth protocol to put Google Maps on the dashboard
item.description: How I reverse-engineered my motorcycle's Bluetooth instrument-cluster protocol with a GATT walk, JADX, and Frida, then built REDLINE, an Android app for it.

item.title: Stop trusting 'looks about right': verifying AI UI against Figma
item.description: How I built figma-connect and verify_node: a local tool that renders an AI agent's generated code and pixel-diffs it against the live Figma design.

item.title: How I Use AI Without Writing Garbage Code
item.description: AI is a multiplier, not a replacement. It multiplies what you already know. Here's my workflow for getting speed from AI without sacrificing code quality.

item.title: What Happens When You Drop the Framework
item.description: Performance audit and frontend rework of TradersConnect's website: taking Lighthouse from 67 to 100, GTmetrix from C to A, and fully loaded time from 3.3s to 1.0s. Pure HTML/CSS, zero frameworks.

item.title: The Case Against SPAs in 2026
item.description: I build single-page applications for a living. My own portfolio is plain HTML. Here's why that's not a contradiction, and why most websites shouldn't be SPAs.

item.title: How I Migrated a Production App from CRA to Next.js
item.description: A detailed walkthrough of incrementally migrating a production React app from Create React App to Next.js 14, achieving 60% faster load times and Lighthouse scores above 90.
